## add read-base split columns to error.parquet

```
level: medium
date: 2026-10-13
```

### description

The user asked whether the `--error-out` Parquet can also carry
`to_a`/`to_c`/`to_g`/`to_t` and whether that is cheap. After a feasibility
answer, the user chose the 4-column option (no `to_n`). `to_x` counts
in-region substitutions at each 1-based position whose read (destination)
base is x.

### result

1. Implemented `to_a`/`to_c`/`to_g`/`to_t` columns in `error.parquet` (9-column schema).
2. Answered the cost question: negligible CPU, small memory, modest file growth.
3. Documented the N-base semantics in `docs/usage.qmd`.

### change

Files:
- updated: `src/sam_tagger/stats/error_stats.py`, `src/sam_tagger/parquet_writer.py`
- updated: `tests/test_stats.py`, `tests/test_parquet_writer.py`, `docs/usage.qmd`
- created: `docs/plans/20261013-173612_add-error-out-to-cols.plan.qmd`,
  `docs/plans/20261013-173948_add-error-out-to-cols.report.qmd`,
  `docs/misc/next_and_recommendation.qmd`, `docs/misc/requirements_audit.qmd`

Git:
- `9819fe4` feat: split error.parquet mismatch counts by read base

Packages/Environments: None

## release v0.3.0 on github

```
level: high
date: 2026-10-13
```

### description

The user asked to release a new version on GitHub. I read this as cutting
the next release so the published artifact carries the new `error.parquet`
`to_*` columns. I chose `0.3.0` (minor) because the change is a new,
user-visible output feature, following the v0.2.0 precedent.

### result

1. Released v0.3.0: version bumped in three files, commit `aa52fcc`, annotated tag `v0.3.0`, `main` + tag pushed.
2. Created the GitHub Release with curated notes documenting the `to_*` semantics and the N-base caveat.
3. Verified `sam-tagger --version` reports `0.3.0`; workflow conclusions checked via a background watcher.

### change

Files:
- updated: `pyproject.toml`, `pixi.toml`, `src/sam_tagger/__init__.py`
- created: `docs/plans/20261013-174513_release-v0.3.0.plan.qmd`,
  `docs/plans/20261013-175022_release-v0.3.0.report.qmd`
- updated: `docs/misc/requirements_audit.qmd`, `docs/misc/next_and_recommendation.qmd`
